name: xyz.proofofstock/proof-of-stock
title: Proof of Stock
description: RWA: is this stock token the issuer's? Base and Robinhood Chain, with a list hash to recheck.

tools.name: find_stock_token
tools.description: Find issuer-listed tokenized stocks on a chain by ticker, company name or ISIN. Returns the official contract addresses. An empty result says only that the issuer lists no such token, nothing about impostors. Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinhood's, e.g. NVDA). When the user names no chain, call it for both. Facts with their time and source, not advice: https://proofofstock.xyz/docs/legal.md

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

query.description: a ticker (NVDA or NVDAc), a company name (Tesla) or an ISIN (US67066G1040)

tools.name: list_stock_tokens
tools.description: List every token in a chain's issuer registry: symbol, name, contract address, ISIN, multiplier, whether it is minted on the chain and whether the issuer publishes a reference price. The answer opens with the exact count (also the `count` field); quote that number, do not estimate it from the list. On Base many listed tokens are not minted yet and do not trade (`minted`). Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinhood's, e.g. NVDA). When the user names no chain, call it for both. Facts with their time and source, not advice: https://proofofstock.xyz/docs/legal.md

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

tools.name: stock_passport
tools.description: Passport of one token address: whether it is in the issuer registry (and, if not, which listed stock its name imitates); the issuer reference price and its age; the latest DEX price and its premium over the reference; the premium series split by US market session; and every gap named. Readings are recorded every 15 minutes (latest.cadence_s), so "latest" is a recorded reading, not a live quote: see latest.age_s. premium compares the latest on-chain price with the issuer reference, whose own age is reference.age_s; when the two are far apart in time, latest.premium_at_reference_time gives the premium of one moment. sources names every source and the pool rule. Every answer opens with one plain sentence; quote it. In the JSON, premium and spread are FRACTIONS (0.01 = 1%; premium > 0 means the on-chain price is above the issuer's), *_age_s and age_s are seconds before generated_at, prices are USD per token. A token is worth `multiplier` shares, and the issuer's reference is already per token. reference.kind: nav_total_return = Coinbase's NAV, token_bid_ask_mid = the mid of Robinhood's token bid/ask. notes are codes for every gap (e.g. reading_stale = our last reading is over 30 min old, pools_capped = the pool count is a minimum). Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinhood's, e.g. NVDA). When the user names no chain, call it for both. Facts with their time and source, not advice: https://proofofstock.xyz/docs/legal.md

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

address.description: the token contract address to check, 0x and 40 hex digits; any token, listed or not

hours.description: how many hours of premium history to summarise, 1 to 24 (this server shows at most 24)

include_series.description: also return series_points, the raw premium time series (large); the session medians in `series` are always there

tools.name: verify_stock_tokens
tools.description: Before buying a token that claims to be a stock, check its contract address: is it on the issuer's own registry for this chain (Base: Coinbase; robinhood: Robinhood)? Up to 50 addresses per call. listed=true is decided by the exact address alone. listed=false means "not in this issuer's registry", not "fake" (it may be another issuer's token); impostor is set only when the token copies a listed symbol or the issuer's naming, and then listed_address is the real one. If the registry cannot be read the call fails rather than answering false. Facts, not advice.

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

addresses.description: the token contract addresses to check, 1 to 50, each 0x and 40 hex digits

tools.name: recent_impostors
tools.description: Tokens on a chain FIRST FLAGGED IN THE LAST 7 DAYS whose symbol or name copies an issuer-listed stock token while their contract is not in that registry, newest first (at most 50), optionally since an ISO time within that window. This is a window, not the whole list: the answer carries `window_days`, `count` for the window and `listed_total` for every look-alike on the list. Each names what it imitates and the listed address. A claim with evidence, not a verdict.

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

since.description: only look-alikes first flagged at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z; omit for the newest 50

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: For shares listed on BOTH Base (Coinbase) and Robinhood Chain (Robinhood), matched by ISIN: per venue the on-chain price's premium over that venue's own issuer reference, the reference kind and age, the deepest pool's liquidity and the multiplier, and the gap (Robinhood premium minus Base premium) when both are current. Raw prices are never compared: multipliers and references differ (Coinbase NAV vs Robinhood bid/ask), so a gap is not a price difference or an arbitrage. Name a share by isin or by ticker (NVDA, or NVDAc); with neither, the 20 rows with the largest gap. A missing premium carries its reason; a reading older than 30 min is flagged stale and gets no gap. Facts, not advice.

isin.description: the share's ISIN, e.g. US67066G1040 for NVIDIA

symbol.description: the ticker, plain or as the issuer writes it (NVDA or NVDAc); give isin or symbol, or neither for the 20 largest gaps

tools.name: verify_anchor
tools.description: Proof that our record of one day has not been changed since: the SHA-256 of that day's manifest of data files, the state of its OpenTimestamps proof (pending, or the Bitcoin block it is in), and the transaction carrying the same hash on Base and on Robinhood Chain. Bitcoin is the root, because Base is sequenced by Coinbase and Robinhood Chain by Robinhood, the two issuers we check; the other two are mirrors, for reach. The answer gives the manifest URL, the proof files and each transaction hash, which is everything needed to check it WITHOUT us. Omit day for the newest anchored day.

day.description: the UTC day to check, e.g. 2026-11-12; omit for the newest anchored day
